For example: MRTM-SNI-001, MRTM-SNI-002. Declare a type whose `idPrefix` is "MRTM-SNI" and these become traced references; if they are safety or security identifiers, declare the role that binds them instead — those sections are read only when the role is declared. Sometimes correct: the prefix may belong to another tool's identifiers — a change request, a drawing number, a supplier's part — in which case nothing is missing, and this line is the confirmation that Sanad is not silently treating them as something they are not. Severity becomes a customer-set option at the read-ledger config stage (#658).
